scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
